Bitcoin ETFs Draw $110 Million as Ether Funds Shed $88.6 Million

According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $110 million in net inflows on October 26, entirely driven by BlackRock's IBIT, bringing its cumulative net inflows to $66.24 billion. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw $88.58 million in net outflows, although Fidelity's FETH led individual fund inflows with $16.13 million. BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, while Fidelity is one of the largest U.S. investment firms. — link

Zcash Co-Founder Proposes Redirecting 8% of Block Subsidies to Network Sustainability Mechanism

Zcash co-founder and protocol developer Sean Bowe has submitted a draft Zcash Improvement Proposal (ZIP) to end the 8% block subsidy allocation to Zcash Community Grants (ZCG) and redirect it to the Network Sustainability Mechanism (NSM), withholding the funds from immediate circulation.

Grayscale Says Zcash's 20% Developer Funding Has Fueled a Decade of Innovation

Grayscale, a leading digital asset manager, highlighted Zcash's (ZEC) continued innovation ahead of its 10th anniversary on October 28, attributing part of its progress to the allocation of 20% of block rewards to developer funding. The privacy-focused cryptocurrency has evolved through multiple shielded pools, from Sprout and Sapling to Orchard and the 2026 Ironwood upgrade, which introduced quantum-recoverable addresses and formal verification to address security vulnerabilities. — link

Sixpence to run points campaign on Robinhood Chain with 10,000 USDG rewards

Sixpence, an onchain money market for tokenized U.S. stocks, will run a points campaign on Robinhood Chain from October 26 at 00:00 to November 23 at 00:00 (UTC), with a total reward pool of 10,000 USDG, split into two periods of 5,000 USDG each. Sixpence allows users to borrow stablecoins against tokenized U.S. stocks such as AAPL, TSLA, and NVDA, or deposit stock tokens into a Vault to earn interest. The project raised $5 million in seed funding from investors including a16z CSX. — link

Passport hardware wallet maker Foundation said it has identified more than 23,000 phishing email attempts, including 19,057 messages delivered through Mailgun and 1,503 sent via Google Workspace. The number of affected users remains unknown.

Hyperliquid: Kraken Parent Payward Plans to Become First CFTC-Regulated HIP-3* Deployer

Hyperliquid announced that Kraken parent Payward plans to become the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3* deployer, using Hyperliquid infrastructure to offer perpetual futures markets to U.S. clients. Subject to regulatory approval, Payward's CFTC-regulated DCM and DCO, Bitnomial, would serve as the deployer, managing the markets and clearing and settling contracts, while its CFTC-registered FCM, NinjaTrader Clearing, would carry client accounts. Ethereum Delays Glamsterdam Hoodi Fork Over EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 Risks

Ethereum researcher Toni Wahrstätter said the planned Glamsterdam fork on the Hoodi testnet has been delayed after ChainSecurity identified compatibility risks in EIP-8037 and EIP-8038. The gas changes could break contracts that assume gas usage only decreases or cause failed sub-calls to behave unexpectedly. ChainSecurity has found 13 real-world cases, and developers are reviewing whether the upgrade specification needs changes. — link

Jack Dorsey's Bitcoin-Enabled Bitchat Tops France's App Store Social Chart

Jack Dorsey's decentralized messaging app Bitchat topped France's App Store Social Networking chart following nationwide protests and an Orange network outage on October 21. The app enables offline messaging via Bluetooth mesh networks, supports Nostr-based communication, and integrates Bitcoin-backed Cashu eCash payments. — link

CZ Attends Nasdaq Bell-Ringing Ceremony for World's Largest Corporate BNB Treasury Firm

Nasdaq-listed BNB Standard Corporation (NASDAQ: BNC) rang the opening bell at Nasdaq's MarketSite in Times Square, New York, to mark its rebranding and the appointment of Alex Odagiu as CEO. Formerly known as CEA Industries, the company officially changed its name on September 29. Its business includes managing a corporate BNB treasury, and it plans to operate a validator node on BNB Chain. The company claims to hold the world's largest corporate BNB treasury. — link

Akash Network selects Solana for blockchain migration

Akash Network said it has selected Solana as the destination for its planned blockchain migration. The decentralized GPU and AI compute network currently runs its own Cosmos SDK-based chain, but previously said it intends to move to a shared-security architecture to reduce network maintenance costs and the capital burden associated with AKT staking. Solana and Ethereum had both been under consideration before Akash made its final choice. — link

Keystone Breach Exposed 25,964 Purchase Records and Compromised Device Verification Key

Keystone said its latest investigation found that attackers obtained a WebAuth device-authentication key through the website breach, potentially allowing counterfeit hardware wallets to pass official authenticity checks. The company will destroy 18,835 unsold devices using the old key, pause unshipped orders and switch new production to a replacement key.
